decks.notes: The main focus of this deck is to control the board and disrupt the opponent's strategy using a combination of counterspells, removal spells, and disruptive creatures. By consistently countering spells and removing threats, the deck aims to outpace and outvalue the opponent, ultimately grinding them down while simultaneously gaining card advantage. The inclusion of powerful creatures like Murktide Regent and Harbinger of the Seas provides additional threats and ways to close out the game once the opponent's resources are depleted. The deck's mana base is carefully constructed to support its control elements and provide consistent access to the necessary colors of mana.

The deck focuses on using artifacts to quickly overwhelm the opponent with a flurry of creatures and equipment. By utilizing cards like Mox Opal and Springleaf Drum to generate mana, the deck can play multiple threats early on. Emry, Lurker of the Loch and Thought Monitor provide card advantage and synergy with artifacts, while Kappa Cannoneer and Basim Ibn Ishaq act as powerful finishers. The inclusion of Urza's Saga allows the deck to tutor for key artifacts and further ramp up its aggressive strategy. The key concept of the deck is to swarm the opponent with powerful artifacts and creatures to quickly achieve victory.

This deck focuses on ramping up mana quickly using Utopia Sprawl and Eldrazi Temple to play powerful Eldrazi creatures like Emrakul, the Promised End and Karn, the Great Creator. It controls the board with cards like Kozilek's Command and Malevolent Rumble, while also utilizing cards like Sowing Mycospawn for added advantage. The deck aims to overwhelm opponents with powerful creatures and disruptive spells, while maintaining a strong mana base for consistent plays.

The deck focuses on using a combination of counterspells, removal spells, and card advantage to control the game and outvalue the opponent. It aims to disrupt the opponent's game plan while generating card advantage through cards like Snapcaster Mage and Expressive Iteration. The deck also has a strong finisher in Crackling Drake and utilizes powerful removal spells like Unholy Heat and Flame of Anor to deal with threats. The mana base is designed to support the deck's control strategy and ensure consistent access to both red and blue mana sources.

This Boros Aggro Modern deck focuses on creating a fast and aggressive board presence through powerful creatures like Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer and Seasoned Pyromancer, supported by burn spells like Galvanic Discharge. The deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with a combination of efficient aggro creatures and disruptive spells such as Static Prison, while utilizing cards like Goblin Bombardment for additional reach and threats. With a mix of creature aggression and burn damage, the deck looks to quickly close out games before the opponent can stabilize.

This deck focuses on assembling a powerful combo involving Underworld Breach, Grinding Station, and various artifacts. Emry, Lurker of the Loch helps to recur artifacts from the graveyard, while cards like Mishra's Bauble and Mox Amber provide additional value. The goal is to generate mana with Mox Opal and Breach, then use Grinding Station to mill the opponent out or win with Thassa's Oracle. The deck utilizes control elements like Swan Song and Lightning Bolt to disrupt the opponent's game plan while setting up its own win condition.

The main idea of this deck is to create a fast-paced aggressive strategy that leverages the blink mechanic to gain additional value from creatures and disrupt opponents' strategies. By combining aggressive creatures like Phelia, Exuberant Shepherd and Emperor of Bones with cards like Ephemerate and Flickerwisp, the deck aims to outpace and overwhelm opponents while also disrupting their game plan with cards like Fatal Push and Thoughtseize. The inclusion of powerful blink targets like Boggart Trawler and Overlord of the Balemurk adds a level of resilience and versatility to the strategy.

This deck focuses on ramping up mana quickly with Eldrazi Temple, Utopia Sprawl, and Talisman of Impulse to cast powerful Eldrazi creatures such as Emrakul, the Promised End and World Breaker. It also disrupts opponents with control elements like Karn, the Great Creator and Kozilek's Return. Malevolent Rumble and Sowing Mycospawn provide additional removal and board control. Overall, the strategy revolves around overwhelming the opponent with massive Eldrazi threats while also controlling the board to ensure victory.

This deck focuses on using creature toolbox cards to assemble key pieces for a combo win condition. It utilizes cards like Young Wolf and Agatha's Soul Cauldron to generate value and set up powerful synergies. The deck also includes a variety of utility creatures like Endurance, Strangleroot Geist, and Hapatra, Vizier of Poisons to deal with different threats. The deck is designed to be flexible and adaptive, capable of adjusting its game plan based on the opponent's actions while working towards assembling the necessary components for a game-ending combo.

The main idea of the deck is to use Underworld Breach along with Grinding Station and other artifacts to create a combo that allows for infinite loops and eventually win the game by either decking out the opponent or setting up Thassa's Oracle for a win. Emry, Lurker of the Loch and Tamiyo, Inquisitive Student help with card filtering and recursion, while Urza's Saga provides additional tutoring for key pieces. The deck aims to quickly set up its combo pieces and disrupt the opponent's game plan to secure a victory.

This aggressive deck focuses on a combination of powerful creatures and efficient removal spells to quickly overwhelm the opponent. With a mix of multicolored creatures and spells, supported by land ramp and protection, the deck aims to apply constant pressure and disrupt the opponent's game plan. By utilizing Leyline cards and tribal synergy, the deck can quickly build a board presence and deal significant damage while maintaining control of the battlefield. The flexibility of the deck allows for adaptability to different matchups and strategies, making it a versatile and competitive choice in Modern 1 vs 1 format.

This deck focuses on using creatures with various abilities to create powerful combos and outvalue the opponent. It utilizes cards like Agatha's Soul Cauldron and Dredger's Insight to dig for key pieces, while also using creatures like Yawgmoth, Thran Physician and Grist, the Hunger Tide to generate card advantage and disrupt the opponent's game plan. With access to powerful toolbox creatures like Endurance and Walking Ballista, the deck can adapt to different situations and control the battlefield effectively. By carefully assembling these synergies, the deck aims to overwhelm the opponent and secure victory.

This deck focuses on aggressive creatures with powerful blink effects to disrupt the opponent's strategy. By utilizing cards like Ephemerate and Flickerwisp, this deck can repeatedly exile and return key creatures, triggering valuable enters the battlefield abilities. Cards like Relic of Progenitus and Thoughtseize provide disruption and control elements to slow down the opponent's game plan. With a mix of removal spells like Fatal Push and strong creatures like Solitude and Overlord of the Balemurk, this deck aims to overwhelm the opponent quickly while maintaining control of the battlefield.

This Dimir Control deck focuses on disrupting opponent's strategies through countering spells and removing key threats using cards like Fatal Push and Murktide Regent. It also utilizes card draw and selection with spells like Consider and Thought Scour to find the right answers at the right time. The deck aims to control the game tempo and protect its win conditions while neutralizing threats with a combination of counter magic and targeted removal. It utilizes a mix of efficient removal, card advantage, and disruption to outlast opponents in the long game.

This deck focuses on utilizing mill cards to quickly deplete your opponent's library, while also disrupting their strategy with cards like Surgical Extraction and Fatal Push. By combining cards that synergize with milling, such as Ruin Crab and Hedron Crab, as well as control elements like Archive Trap and Drown in the Loch, this deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with a combination of efficient removal and relentless mill tactics. The key strategy is to disrupt the opponent's game plan while gradually milling their cards to win the game through library depletion.

The deck focuses on utilizing Underworld Breach in combination with Grinding Station and Emry, Lurker of the Loch to quickly loop through your graveyard and deck to win the game with Thassa's Oracle or Malevolent Rumble. Mishra's Bauble and Mox Opal provide additional card advantage and ramp, while Tamiyo, Inquisitive Student helps dig for key combo pieces. The deck also includes some disruption with Aether Spellbomb and Unholy Heat, along with protection in the form of Spell Snare and Soul-Guide Lantern. Overall, the deck aims to efficiently assemble its combo pieces and secure a win in the late game.
